description: This file contains a class 'Extension' in the namespace 'Opencart.Admin.Model.Setting' that provides methods for managing extensions within the OpenCart platform, including CRUD operations, installation, and path management for extensions.

classes.name: Extension
classes.description: Model class for handling extension data including retrieval, installation, uninstallation, and path management in the OpenCart admin setting context.

methods.name: getExtensions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of distinct extension types from the database.

methods.name: getExtensionsByType
methods.description: Fetches all extensions of a specific type.

methods.name: getExtensionByCode
methods.description: Retrieves an extension's details by its type and code.

methods.name: getTotalExtensionsByExtension
methods.description: Counts the total number of extensions of a specific extension type.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Installs a new extension by inserting it into the database.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Uninstalls an extension by removing its record and associated settings.

methods.name: addInstall
methods.description: Adds an extension installation record.

methods.name: deleteInstall
methods.description: Removes an extension installation record by ID.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a specific extension installation.

methods.name: getInstall
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific installation by its ID.

methods.name: getInstallByExtensionDownloadId
methods.description: Fetches installation details using the extension download ID.

methods.name: getInstallByCode
methods.description: Retrieves an installation record by its code.

methods.name: getInstalls
methods.description: Fetches a list of extension installations, with optional filtering and sorting.

methods.name: getTotalInstalls
methods.description: Returns the total count of extension installations.

methods.name: addPath
methods.description: Associates a path with an extension installation.

methods.name: deletePath
methods.description: Deletes a path record by ID.

methods.name: getPathsByExtensionInstallId
methods.description: Retrieves all paths associated with a specific extension installation.

methods.name: getPaths
methods.description: Fetches paths matching a specific pattern.

methods.name: getTotalPaths
methods.description: Counts the total number of paths matching a specific pattern.

methods.name: addInstall
methods.description: Inserts a new extension installation record with provided data.

methods.name: deleteInstall
methods.description: Removes an extension install record by its ID.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of an extension installation.
